read.thesis: Account and ARPA growth drive 9% postpaid service revenue growth and 11% adjusted EBITDA growth; capex down 14% and FY26 capex held at about $10.0B while cash flow guidance raised.

capex.quote: Cash purchases of property and equipment, including capitalized interest are expected to be approximately $10.0 billion.

triggers.label: Adj. FCF guide raised to $18.7-18.8B
triggers.quote: Adjusted Free Cash Flow, including net payments for UScellular merger-related costs, is now expected to be between $18.7 billion and $18.8 billion

triggers.label: Q3 capex down 14% YoY
triggers.quote: Cash purchases of property and equipment, including capitalized interest, decreased 14% year-over-year to $2.3 billion.

guidance.quote: Postpaid net account additions are expected to be approximately 1.0 million, at the midpoint of the previous guide of 950 thousand to 1.05 million.
Core Adjusted EBITDA, which is Adjusted EBITDA less lease revenues, is expected to be between $37.35 billion and $37.45 billion
is now expected to be between $28.7 billion and $28.8 billion, an increase at the midpoint
Cash purchases of property and equipment, including capitalized interest, are expected to be approximately $10.0 billion.
Adjusted Free Cash Flow, including net payments for UScellular merger-related costs, is now expected to be between $18.7 billion and $18.8 billion
Effective tax rate is now expected to be between 24% and 25%, a decrease from prior guidance of between 25% and 26%.

prior_guidance_check.quote: Postpaid net account additions of 274 thousand

red_flags.label: Operating cash flow down 2% YoY
red_flags.quote: Net cash provided by operating activities of $7.3 billion decreased 2% year-over-year

red_flags.label: Special items rising in Other, net
red_flags.quote: Other, net for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and June 30, 2026, includes $50 million and $108 million
